title: Easy Stairs - (the way it really should be)
description: This project adds recipes for ALL stair types, having 3 of the blocks making 4 stairs, rather than 6 blocks for 4 stairs.
body: Clearly someone forgot to teach mojang how math works, 6 planks for 4 3/4 planks, clearly this doesn't make ANY sense. This modpack makes it so that 3 of your desired materials to make 4 of your stairs, this is mathamatically, and logically correct, and it is the way it SHOULD have been from the start.
